WITHDRAWN AS PROOF — 2026-10-13. The historical T1′–T4 argument is invalid as a proof of the Riemann hypothesis. T2 omits nonzero Gram-matrix diagonal terms; T3 asserts an incompatible wave-packet normalization. Scientific erratum.

RETIRÉ COMME PREUVE. L’argument historique T1′–T4 est invalidé comme preuve de l’hypothèse de Riemann. T2 omet des termes diagonaux non nuls de la matrice de Gram ; T3 affirme une normalisation incompatible du paquet d’ondes.

This DOI identifies the historical T1′–T4 archive. The source documents are preserved for provenance. The withdrawal does not certify unrelated finite computations, independent review or mathematical priority.
